name: reeldock-extension
description: Browser extension for queuing YouTube videos into a local reeldock instance.

scripts.lint: node scripts/lint.mjs && node scripts/check-store.mjs && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.mjs
scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext lint -s dist/firefox
scripts.package: npm run package:chrome && npm run package:firefox
